cases.name: Nora Sánchez
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "was born in Palmira, Valle del Cauca, Colombia to Ramon and Alicia Toro Sánchez. She came to the United States in the 1980s and lived a quiet and reserved life in New Holland, PA, a place she loved greatly. Nora was a beloved mother, sister, aunt, and friend. She was a humble, loving, generous, hardworking woman, whose kind disposition will be remembered by all who knew her."

https://lancasteronline.com/obituaries/nora-s-nchez/article_61f0e151-7296-5398-9050-0450d5853429.html

She worked as a housekeeper. “Nora was a very good neighbor,” one neighbor said. “You couldn’t have had a better neighbor. I want justice for this woman.”

https://www.pennlive.com/news/2021/12/woman-who-didnt-know-a-sex-offender-lived-upstairs-was-sexually-assaulted-killed-by-him-prosecutors.html
cases.narrative: On 9/1/2021, the property manager crawled through the window and discovered she was dead and also discovered grocery bags with perishable items left out at room temperature, with receipts timestamped Aug. 31 around 1 p.m., hinting that she had been ambushed when she returned from the store.
